text:
tara_security: Quick ask — a partner wants a near-real-time SIEM export (syslog/S3) that contains masked PII, retention of 14 days for the exported copy, and a distinct RBAC boundary. They also want the ability to hand back full data for forensics under subpoena. Any recommended pattern for RBAC + KMS + audit trail? @eric_ops @nora_privsec

eric_ops: Short answer: proxy the export behind a service account with a scoped role, and use a timebound KMS unwrap for full-handoffs. Keep the original logs in our long-term store (retention policy unchanged). Export copies should be derived artifacts with their own lifecycle.

sam_sre: Agreed. Concretely: create an siem_exporter role that has read access only to a pre-filtered dataset (no raw full-event view). Exporter writes to an S3 bucket encrypted with a customer-managed key (CMK) that we control. Exports are redacted before wrapping.

nora_privsec: A few caveats: (1) define a legal/forensics path for full unmasking and require a formal ticket + attestation; (2) log every KMS Decrypt/Unwrap call to the audit trail, and ship those to a separate, immutable audit index; (3) DLP scan exports to ensure masking rules applied correctly.

sec-bot: Reminder: KMS policy audit rule triggered on grant/ungrant events and decrypt operations. See: https://go/to/kms-audit-playbook :eyes:

erric_ops: (typo) ^ eric_ops :)

eric_ops: Example exporter config we've used in staging:```yaml
exporter:
  role: siem_exporter
  redact: true
  redact_mode: field_masking
  export_ttl_days: 14
  destination: s3://partner-exports/prod/
  kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/siem/cryptoKeys/exporter
  audit_topic: projects/redwood/topics/siem-export-audit
```

sam_sre: Implementation notes: - Use envelope encryption: exporter uses a service key that is itself wrapped by the CMK so we can rotate the wrapper without re-encrypting exported blobs. - Don't give partner direct KMS access. Partners get files only, over signed URLs or via a partner pull with short-lived creds.

nora_privsec: RBAC: create two groups: exports_readonly (partner-accessible for S3 objects only) and exports_admin (internal; can request unmask). exports_admin requires 2FA + group approval. All requests for unmask must create a ticket in the forensic queue and require manager approval.

sec-bot: Suggestion: enable object-level metadata that records the export-filtering-policy-id and a checksum of the redaction rules applied. That helps validate exported copy against policy later.

tara_security: How do we handle subpoena/unmasking in practice? We don't want to auto-unmask on any request.

nora_privsec: For subpoena: require (A) legal signoff, (B) SRE/infra approve ephemeral KMS grant (timeboxed, logged), (C) forensics team performs unmask in a controlled environment that records a full chain-of-custody. No one-shot key unwraps without workflow.

eric_ops: Operationally: add a JIT endpoint that issues a short-lived unwrap token after ticket+approvals. Token is single-use and recorded in audit. Token TTL=1 hour, default scope=unpack-only in a locked-forensics cluster.

sam_sre: For backwards compatibility, ensure exported schema keeps an event_id mapping back to the original log so we can cross-reference without exposing full content. Also include a signed manifest next to each export with the redaction policy version used.

tara_security: Nice. Any thoughts on retention enforcement? We need to make sure partner copies are deleted after 14 days even if they request re-delivery.

eric_ops: Enforce with lifecycle rules on the export bucket + periodic tombstone job that verifies deletion. Also record deletion in audit topic. If partner wants re-delivery after TTL, require a fresh export (re-run redaction) and go through the same approval flow.

nora_privsec: Add alerts for any export that outlives TTL (SaaS monitor + infra job) and auto-escalate to oncall.

audits_automation: We can wire a daily report: list of exports created, redaction rule ids, deletion events, and any KMS decrypt events tied to export IDs. We can push as weekly digest to security-owners.

sam_sre: Next steps — infra ticket to create siem_exporter role + S3 bucket + CMK stub; sec to provide redaction policy and forensic workflow doc; audits to add report pipeline. Would like an owner for each.

tara_security: I'll own product/requirements and legal handoff. @eric_ops take infra owner? @nora_privsec will own policy/workflow. I'll open a tracking ticket and link docs. :white_check_mark:

eric_ops: I'll open INFRA-2761 with the basic bucket+IAM+kms stub and tag for review.

nora_privsec: I'll draft the unmasking SOP and approval template. ETA EOD tomorrow.

sec-bot: New TODOs created: INFRA-2761, SEC-9028, AUDIT-1133.

tara_security: Great — thanks everyone. We'll iterate on the SOP and test in staging before enabling partner exports. :thumbsup:
